name: filter-int64-numeric-ordering
$comment: A string filter value on an indexed int64 field is the typed-bigint wire form and orders NUMERICALLY: gt("9") over {15, 9, -605, 1000000000000} keeps 15 and 1000000000000 (lexicographic decimal-string compare would keep neither — "15" < "9" and "1..." < "9"). Found by the ENH-027 property test (server/tests/proptest_parity.rs), minimized; expect derived from the server. The rust engine was fixed with the case; ts/python engines still compare the strings lexicographically (compareLeaf/compare_leaf) and skip loudly until mirrored.

skip.ts: compareLeaf compares int64 decimal strings lexicographically; needs the typed-numeric arm the rust engine got (ENH-027)
skip.python: filter compare compares int64 decimal strings lexicographically; needs the typed-numeric arm the rust engine got (ENH-027)
